### What are Corporate Gifts?

Corporate Gifts are the products corporate companies give to their clients, employees and other associates. These are branded with company logo to ensure branding at the same time. Promotional gifts are used in marketing and communication programs, are given to promote a company, brand or event and as a part of guerrilla marketing campaigns.

### What are types of different Corporate Gifts?

Corporate Gifts are often decided by companies on the basis of their target receivers. Promotional products can be anything from office utilities to personal accessories to household items. Office utility products like diaries, t-shirts, trophies, folders, backpacks, desktop items, pens make a perfect gift for employee rewards and appreciation. There are products like power banks, trolley bags, drinkwares, writing instruments, and wallets etc. which are used by companies to gift to clients. Low budget promotional products like pens, handbags, keychains etc. are very useful in mass promotional and brand building. Unique products vases, wall hangings, frames, kitchen utilities, fitness products, hardware tools, pen drives are often preferred by corporates as special gifts. Special occasions, Diwali, Christmas, New Year gifts have unique combinations of gifts along with sweets / dryfruits / chocolates etc.

### Things to keep in mind while selecting branded promotional gifts:

- Design is the most important thing about your branded corporate gift.
- Do not pick the same monotonous style, go for trendy ones.
- You should remember the utility or usefulness of the corporate gifts.
- Never compromise with the quality.
- Be very specific while selecting the gift to enhance the scope of advertising.

### Benefits of Branded Corporate Gifts:

- Corporate gifts are kept for a long time, this helps with branding.
- Branded promotional gifts improve customers' opinion about your company.
- Corporate gift marketing cost per impression is less than any other form of advertising.
- You can give corporate gift to clients on various occasions such as Diwali, New Year, Holi etc. recalling your brand image.

### Corporate Gift Ideas for Employees and Clients

Who doesn’t like a nice, meaningful gift? We all love it when we receive a little surprise packed with beautiful wrapping paper. The excitement of opening the pack and discovering what’s inside is an experience we all enjoy. However, we never want to feel disappointed seeing a gift that makes no sense or adds nothing to our lives.

Gifting is an art that requires proper thought and effort to make it work. Be it personal or professional, selecting the right gift is not an easy task. It becomes even more challenging if you want to send a corporate gift during the festive season. A corporate gift is not just a token that you send to tick things off from your official To-Do list, it’s a representation of your corporate identity, your thoughtfulness towards your business partners/employees, your willingness to go the distance and make the effort to choose the right gift and a lot more.
